title: Inbound delivery record at .supervisor/ledger/inbound/<I-id>.json (Overview C11). Written by the runtime only (runtime.routing, and the publish hook for acknowledgements). The inbound message itself stays immutable at comms/inbox/<inbound id>.json.

id.description: The inbound id: an I-id from comms inbound, or the external agent's own id for a file it wrote directly (comms.inbound.INBOUND_ID).

kind.description: The inbound message's kind: one of the inbound kinds in comms/inbound/ (the registry; the message was validated against it).

responsible.description: The one responsible card: a task id once known, the card request (Q-id) it was routed to, and/or backlog=true for the planning backlog (bound to a planning card's task id when one takes it). All null/false for a seen, or for a task rejected with a runtime note.

acknowledged_by.description: The published message (M-id) that acknowledged it; null until then (and for a seen).

final_ack_by.description: For a task first acknowledged with outcome blocked: the runtime follow-up note (M-id) that carries its final outcome (runtime_key ack-final:<inbound id>). Absent until then, and for every other record.

late.description: A reply that arrived after the expires time of the message it answers.

thread.description: Thread key of the outbound message it answers (its thread, else its id); absent when it answers nothing.
